story_text: As a user, I want the system to return an error when I try to get a task with a non-existent ID so that I know the task does not exist.

positive.title: Get task with valid-format but non-existent ID
steps: 1. Send GET request to /tasks/{id} with a valid UUID that does not exist in the system.
2. Observe the response status code and body.

positive.title: Error response schema validation for not-found task
steps: 1. Send GET request to /tasks/{id} with a valid UUID that does not exist in the system.
2. Observe the response status code and body.
positive.expected_result: Body matches agreed error schema · Content-Type: application/json

negative.title: Get task with invalid ID format
steps: 1. Send GET request to /tasks/{id} with an invalid ID format (e.g., 'abc123').
2. Observe the response status code and body.

negative.title: Get task with alphanumeric ID
steps: 1. Send GET request to /tasks/{id} with an alphanumeric ID.
2. Observe the response status code and body.

edge.title: Get task with ID = 0
steps: 2. Observe the response status code and body.
edge.expected_result: 400 Bad Request or 404 Not Found · no 500

edge.title: Get task with negative ID
steps: 2. Observe the response status code and body.
edge.expected_result: 400 Bad Request or 404 Not Found · no 500
